info.title: Journee API
info.description: API documentation for Journee travel tracking application with JWT authentication, location tracking, and social features

get.description: Validates the token and returns the current user profile

post.description: Updates location and creates/updates journal entry based on location logic. If same location, updates departure time. If different location, closes previous entry and creates new one.

get.description: Returns today's journal and the latest entry for the authenticated user

get.summary: Get journal by ID with entries
